The indirect pathway through Cefamandole and Linezolid further supports this relationship, as these antibiotics are also used in the treatment of similar infections. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of support for the relationship, though the evidence is not strong enough to definitively establish a causal link. The presence of overlapping indications and the shared pathophysiological processes suggest that Cefotaxime may contribute to the development of Staphylococcal Pneumonia through mechanisms involving bacterial susceptibility and immune response modulation.
